title: GRUN: Generalized Retinex Unfolding Network for Image Restoration
abstract: arXiv:2611.31690v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Image restoration remains a fundamental challenge in low-level vision, requiring methods that handle diverse degradations while preserving scene structures and details. We revisit classical Retinex theory and propose a Generalized Retinex formulation that extends the illumination-reflectance decomposition into a Retinex-inspired content-environment factorization prior for image restoration. The key idea is to restore images using two learned factors: a content-dominant response (generalized reflectance) capturing scene properties and an environment-side response (generalized illumination) encoding task-dependent variations associated with the observed degradations. Based on this formulation, we develop GRUN (Generalized Retinex Unfolding Network), a MAP-guided deep unfolding framework that alternates reflectance restoration, illumination estimation, and progressive degradation inference across K stages with degradation-conditioned prox

translated_title: GRUN：面向图像修复的广义Retinex展开网络
translated_abstract: 图像修复仍然是底层视觉领域中的一项基础性挑战，需要方法能够在处理多样化退化的同时保留场景结构与细节。我们重新审视了经典的Retinex理论，提出了一种广义Retinex公式，将传统的光照-反射分解扩展为一种受Retinex启发的内容-环境因子分解先验，用于图像修复。其核心思想是利用两个可学习因子来恢复图像：一个捕捉场景属性的内容主导响应（广义反射分量），以及一个编码与观测退化相关的任务依赖变化的环境侧响应（广义光照分量）。基于这一公式，我们开发了GRUN（广义Retinex展开网络），这是一个由最大后验概率（MAP）引导的深度展开框架，它在K个阶段中交替执行反射分量恢复、光照估计以及渐进式退化推断，并采用以退化为条件的邻近算子（摘要至此截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出广义Retinex公式与MAP引导的深度展开网络GRUN，将经典光照-反射分解泛化为内容-环境因子分解先验，通过交替进行反射恢复、光照估计和渐进式退化推断，实现对多种退化类型图像的修复。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GRUN, a MAP-guided deep unfolding network that generalizes classical Retinex decomposition into a content-environment factorization prior, alternately performing reflectance restoration, illumination estimation, and progressive degradation inference for versatile image restoration.
